heading: Client access.
intro: Summit Asset Management provides online access for clients through a web-portal.

portal.heading: Accounts, reports and documents.
paragraphs: With online access, clients can view their accounts, see customized reports, receive communications from Summit, and share and store documents through a protected website.
To learn more about this feature, please contact your financial advisor or call 901.729.8100.
If you are an existing client with an active portal, use the link below to log in. It will take you to Tamarac’s portal login page.
portal.linkLabel: Log in to the Summit Client Portal

schwab.heading: Charles Schwab online access.
paragraphs: Summit Asset Management, LLC has selected Charles Schwab & Co., Inc. (“Schwab”) as primary custodian for our clients’ accounts. Charles Schwab & Co., Inc. provides online access to account information.
In order to view accounts online you must be signed up with Schwab for web-viewing. The link below will take you away from Summit’s website to the Schwab website.
Call Schwab Signature Services Alliance at 800.515.2157 to get online access to your Schwab accounts or if you are having difficulty viewing your accounts online.
